modules.question_or_claim: Explain alternative geometry assumptions, finite-library inference and proposed extensions without claiming illustrations are measured evidence.

Correct conceptual diagrams/derivations and explicit list of speculative extensions
modules.policy: Documentation and mathematical correctness; no invented empirical score for cartoons. Any generative illustrations are labeled prospective.
open_gaps: Exact figure projection/generative source absent

modules.question_or_claim: Local stereotypy, sparse geometry and many-to-one neural-to-behavior mapping.
required_outputs: Full-dimensional neural/muscle/kinematic distance histograms
Matched partition A/B neural control
100000 state-pair ordering comparisons and reported concordance
Projection bases and explained-variance diagnostics
modules.policy: 10 ms trajectories; neural Euclidean distance; z-scored seven-EMG muscle distance; circularly normalized phase plus angular velocity; 50 ms muscle and 150 ms kinematic lags; axiswise mean-distance normalization; partition A only for behavior comparisons.
open_gaps: Original partitions/random draws/histogram bins and projection bases
Cycle template/warp/source joins

modules.question_or_claim: Decode common muscle output across orthogonal reaching and cycling neural dynamics.
required_outputs: Frozen simulated network/trajectory lineage
Full consecutive held-test output trace, R2, correlation, MAE
Task-switching/latent geometry checks
modules.policy: Eight reach plus one cycle condition; 1200 neurons; original 500 trials; 135 consecutive test trials (~7.1 minutes), 15 training trials/condition selected from remaining trials. Source Table2 reports 270 used trials.
open_gaps: Original simulation model/config/seed/selected intervals
Source code commit and dependencies not yet bound

MC_RTT 660 ms paper versus 920 ms recorded code discrepancy

1 Hz figure/Methods versus 2 Hz narrative conflict
